evals.prompt: Create an isolated worktree for a new login feature branch. Keep my current checkout untouched.
evals.expected_output: Inspect isolation and convention root, enforce the repo .gitignore gate, plan-create with --mode new-branch, and execute git worktree add -b only when ok_to_create is true.
assertions: Uses git-worktree helper inspect and plan-create
Does not run git worktree add before plan-create reports gitignore_covers true

evals.prompt: List the git worktrees in this repo and tell me which convention root they use.
evals.expected_output: Run plan-list and report registered paths plus the resolved convention root without creating a new worktree.
assertions: Runs plan-list or git worktree list --porcelain through the helper

evals.prompt: Remove the worktree I created for feat/login after the branch is done.
evals.expected_output: Run plan-remove with porcelain -uall, exact path match, lock, in-progress, and owner checks. Execute remove only when ok_to_remove is true.
assertions: Uses plan-remove before git worktree remove
Refuses if the tree is dirty, locked, or unowned

evals.prompt: The worktree root is not in .gitignore. Create an isolated worktree for feat/login.
evals.expected_output: Run plan-create, which appends the planned ignore line when write_required is true, then execute git worktree add only when ok_to_create is true. Do not stage or commit .gitignore.
assertions: plan-create appends the resolved root to the repo .gitignore when write_required is true
Does not run git worktree add while gitignore_covers is false
Does not git add or git commit the ignore line

evals.prompt: Prune stale worktree metadata for the whole repo.
evals.expected_output: Run plan-prune, show dry-run candidates, keep ok_to_prune false, and wait for explicit authorization before git worktree prune.
assertions: Does not run a real prune without authorization

evals.prompt: Adopt the existing .claude/worktrees checkout and make this skill own it.
evals.expected_output: Refuse. Adopt is out of scope for this skill MVP.
assertions: Does not rewrite ownership of a foreign worktree by default

evals.prompt: 帮我把这些改动提交了
evals.expected_output: Near-neighbor negative: a commit request should route to git-commit, not git-worktree.

evals.prompt: 我的 PR CI 红了，帮我修一下，然后准备发 GitHub Release。
evals.expected_output: Near-neighbor negative: PR CI and release work should route to gh-pr-release, including any detached tag-build worktree.
assertions: Does not invoke git-worktree for the release detached worktree
